title: Windows LAPS or Managing Local Admin Passwords by Hand
excerpt: Shared local administrator passwords let one compromised machine unlock the rest. Windows LAPS, built into supported Windows versions since April 2023, sets a unique, rotating password on every device. Here is why manual management cannot compete.
verdict: For any environment beyond a handful of machines, LAPS is the only sensible option. Manual management does not scale, and in practice it leads to reused passwords that attackers use for lateral movement. If you still run the older, separately installed Microsoft LAPS, plan the move to Windows LAPS.
